text: From boot up to complete in 4 hours and 45 minutes. That's the new time record set by our Wet Dress Rehearsal operators at Launch Complex 1 for our next mission. ESCAPADE’s view of Earth as Blue and Gold pass by on their way to Mars. Two weeks ago, the Rocket Lab-built spacecraft completed powered flybys of Earth two days apart. About three hours later, one spacecraft captured this farewell view of our planet from 38,500 miles away.
